methodology.weight_range_basis: Engineering sensitivity around equal weights; not an estimated confidence interval.
methodology.comparison_group: same declared cohort, stage and applicable families
methodology.rank_bounds: Conservative bounds for all missing-family completions and every shared weight vector inside the box; ties may occupy any position.
methodology.family_or_limit: A confirmed family need not mean all its indicators were observed.

limitations: Rank bounds are conservative and need not be jointly attainable.
Sensitivity box is an engineering assumption, not calibrated uncertainty.
Comparison uses the supplied cohort only, not all SECOP.
Evidence completeness and weight robustness do not establish corruption.
